t: This is St Ann's Terrace, a street in the City of Westminster. Its name comes from Saint Anne, who in Christian tradition is the mother of Mary and so the grandmother of Jesus. The Bible's gospels never name her. Her name, and that of her husband Joachim, comes from early writings outside the New Testament, the Gospel of James being the earliest to mention them. So the street carries the name of a figure known mostly through tradition rather than scripture.
